title: Speaking — Keeping a promise
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on keeping a promise.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Do you prefer written reminders or telling someone when you have made a plan?
How do you decide whether you can commit to an arrangement?

part2.topic: Describe a promise you kept even when it became inconvenient.
points: what made it harder to keep
part2.closing: and explain why you thought it was important to follow through.

questions: How does reliability affect the way people share responsibilities?
When might breaking a commitment be more responsible than keeping it?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to keeping a promise?
